title: Beatrix and the Autopsy
author: R. M. Kavanagh
blurb: Hazel Galloway, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
